name: SVC_CHANNEL_VIA_INT
description: This table stores detailed information about how a service request was received or how an SR Channel was received or sent, and whom it was sent to.

columns.name: VIA_ID
columns.description: This column is same as base table primary key column .

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on ourcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record begin updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_SERVICES_REQUESTS (SR_ID) if this channel is for an SR, or SVC_SR_MESSAGES (MESSAGE_ID) if this channel is for an SR MESSAGE.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates whether the OBJECT_ID is for SR or for SR_Message.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_CHANNELS_B (CHANNEL_ID).

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_CONTACT_POINTS (CONTACT_POINT_ID). The CONTACT_POINT_TYPE column in HZ_CONTACT_POINT will indicate phone, email, etc.  The OWNER_TABLE_NAME column will indicate the table name (such as HZ_PARTIES) that stores the owner of the contact point, and OWNER_TABLE_ID is the foreign key to OWNER_TABLE_NAME that identifies the owner of the contact point.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID).

columns.name: PARTY_VIA_END_POINT
columns.description: Stores the end point used to send the communication to the owner of the PARTY_ID. This column can be an email address, phone number, etc.  When PARTY_ID is null and this column is not null, this end point belongs to an adhoc party.

columns.name: ROUTING_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates how the message was routed to the PARTY_VIA_END_POINT.  For example, if the message is an email, whether the recipient is a TO, CC, or BCC recipient.

columns.name: POST_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Stores the unique identifier for the social media posting that can be used to respond via the same channel instance.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this via record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to the table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required to track multi csv import of service request objects.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: CHANNEL_OSR
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference of channels if record was imported.

columns.name: OBJECT_OSR
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference of Object,if record was imported.

columns.name: CHANNEL_VIA_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Additional column to resolve PARTY_ID using alternate key CHANNEL_VIA_PARTY_NUMBER

columns.name: CHANNEL_VIA_PARTY_ORIG_SYS
columns.description: Additional column to resolve PARTY_ID using origninal system key

columns.name: CHANNEL_VIA_PARTY_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Additional column to resolve PARTY_ID using origninal system reference

columns.name: CHANNEL_VIA_CONT_PT_ORIGSYSREF
columns.description: Additional column to resolve CONTACT_POINT_ID using origninal system reference

columns.name: INBOUND_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Stores the Id value of the Inbound Object, ex: email, social etc
